initial.text: If you can hear Welcome then that means Text to speech is working. If you cannot hear Welcome then that means text to speech is not working. Pres the green button if you  can hear Welcome . Press the red button if you can not hear Welcome.

troubleshoot.text: Were going to troubleshoot text to voice. Press the green button if you can hear the word Welcome. Press the red button if you cannot hear the word welcome.

retry.text: Were still troubleshooting the text to voice. Press green if you can hear Welcome. Press red if you cannot hear Welcome.

success_recording.text: Text o voice is not woring. Youre going to hear the AI talking through the rest of the setup.

fallback.text: Unfortuently text to voice is not working at this time. You can press the green button to continue on withut text to voice. You can also press the purple button if you would like to enable text to voice again. If you do not want to play the game by reading the text on the screen then pressing the red button will end the game and then we will not play the game today until we can get text to voice to work. Press the green button if you would like to keep going without text to voice and read the text instead.

reading_check.text: At this time text to voice has not been working and if you feeling that theres been too much reading going on then what you can do is you can press the red button if you would like to end the game or if you feel that you can continue on by reading the text on the screen then press the green button and you can continue on without text to voice and read the text on the screen instead

continue_check.text: Press the green button to contine our if youre ready to end the game press the red button. Press the green button if you would like to continue.
